Our Mission

To gather, preserve, and share the songs and prayers of UECFI Area 4 in the languages our community speaks and worships in — making it simple for every member to contribute, find, and lead others in worship with confidence.

Our Vision

A connected worship community where lyrics and prayers — in English, Tagalog, Ilocano, Igorot, and Ifugao — are always within reach, growing as a living, shared library that is carried forward from one generation of believers to the next.
